prompt: Given meeting time intervals `intervals = [[0, 30], [5, 10], [15, 20]]` where `intervals[i] = [start, end]`, what is the minimum number of conference rooms required so no two overlapping meetings share a room?
explanation: The minimum number of rooms equals the maximum number of concurrent overlapping meetings at any point in time. A sweep-line or min-heap on end times determines that 2 room(s) are needed.
